Hello Orel,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
ZEN-EV
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P4 170000450
Charger ID/Serial No.:
YB7uye
Problem Description:
convertor problem
We have checked the charger on SCB and found that charger is having
Converter not found, CanCommLoss error
in active error flag. Please find below image for your reference.
Please review the following steps to troubleshoot the power converter:
Verify that the power converter is properly secured and connected to its shelf case.
Check for any loose connections in the power cables or CAN communication cables. Measure the voltage across the connections using a multimeter and check the resistance across the CAN communication cables.
Confirm whether the power converter display is in the OFF or ON state.
Swap the suspected faulty power converter with a known good one. If the error flag changes to indicate the new converter, we can conclude that the original converter is faulty.
If the issue persists after performing all the above steps, we recommend replacing the power converter, as rework is not feasible.
Please ensure that all electrical safety procedures are followed, including the use of appropriate PPE.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [
4/8/2024
], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
